sentences.text:
The petitioner was convicted for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and sentenced to undergo life imprisonment with a fine of Rs 10,000/- by the Sessions Court at Hajipur in connection with Sessions Trial No.
115 of 2009 arising out of Rajapakar P.S. Case No. 154 of 2007.
His appeal was dismissed by the High Court under the impugned order.
The petitioner is in jail for a period of 16 years, which fact is admitted by learned counsel for the respondent-State.
Considering the period of incarceration, we are of the opinion that a case for bail is made out.
Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail till the pendency of this petition, on usual terms and conditions to be decided by the concerned Court.
List the petition for hearing on 08.04.2025.

(RENU BALA GAMBHIR) COURT MASTER (SH) ASSISTANT REGISTRAR Akhilesh Kumar @ Akhilesh Rai @ Aklesh ... vs The State Of Bihar on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146559338/
